info.title: AJBKu API
info.description: Platform operasional notaris dan PPAT Indonesia - B2B SaaS

tenantCode.description: Kode tenant kantor. Optional untuk CLIENT/NOTARY v3; jika kosong backend memakai tenant AJBKu.

idToken.description: Google ID token obtained by the frontend.

accessToken.description: Supabase access token hasil login email+password admin

factorId.description: Optional factor ID TOTP. Jika kosong, backend pilih faktor TOTP terverifikasi pertama.

address.example: Jl. TB Simatupang No. 10, Jakarta Selatan

logoUrl.description: Optional absolute logo URL. Official private-storage flow should use logo upload endpoints and then pass logoStorageKey instead.

logoStorageKey.description: Canonical private-storage reference returned by the logo upload flow. If provided, backend will derive logoUrl from storage.

officeId.description: Required for admin-created matters. Ignored for CLIENT role - server resolves the tenant default office.

clientProfileId.description: Ignored for CLIENT role - server always resolves from the authenticated user's profile. Optional for compatibility with admin-created matters.

WorkflowStatus.description: New workflow status to transition the matter to.

status.description: New workflow status to transition the matter to.

description.description: Optional note for this status change, stored in the timeline.

docType.description: Document type. Compatibility aliases: sppt_pbb -> pbb, other -> lainnya, and legacy party-specific aliases like ktp-penjual map to documentType + partyRole.

ownerClientProfileId.description: Optional owner client profile UUID for document ownership scoping. Primarily for compatibility with older clients.

partyRole.description: Optional role of the party this document belongs to. Uniqueness is enforced per matterId + documentType + partyRole.

url.description: S3-compatible presigned PUT URL. Frontend must upload the file directly to this URL without an Authorization header.

token.description: Always null for S3-compatible storage because credentials are embedded in the signed URL query parameters.

message.example: Client profile does not own this matter

storageKey.description: Object key returned by the presign endpoint. The object must exist in S3-compatible storage before complete is accepted.

revisionNote.description: Wajib diisi jika status verification adalah needs_revision.

extractedData.description: Data hasil ekstraksi manual atau OCR.

url.description: S3-compatible presigned GET URL for document download.

notaryId.description: UUID notaris dari daftar rekomendasi matter.

scheduledAt.description: Tanggal dan waktu jadwal tanda tangan dalam ISO 8601.

notes.description: Catatan tambahan untuk klien atau internal.

scheduledAt.description: Tanggal dan waktu baru dalam ISO 8601.

notes.description: Catatan opsional untuk konteks tambahan tahap ini.

bpnReferenceNumber.description: Nomor referensi resmi dari kantor BPN.

body.example: Tahap BPN untuk matter Anda telah diperbarui.

message.example: Tahap BPN untuk matter Anda telah diperbarui.

email.description: Email klien yang akan diundang ke matter.

code.description: Manual invitation code provided by admin to the client via email or WhatsApp. Generated by the server when admin creates an invitation via POST /api/v1/matters/{matterId}/invitations.

manualCode.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for older clients. Use code instead.
